+name: AI PR Review
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize, edited, reopened, ready_for_review]
+
+jobs:
+  ai_review:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout code
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Fetch PR Diff
+        run: |
+          git fetch origin ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
+          git diff origin/${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }} HEAD > pr_diff.txt
+
+      - name: Debug PR Diff Content
+        run: |
+          cat pr_diff.txt
+
+      - name: Run ESLint
+        run: |
+          npx eslint src
+
+      - name: Format Codebase with Prettier
+        run: |
+          npx prettier src --write
+
+      - name: Disable Lodash Imports for Testing
+        run: |
+          sed -i 's/^import _$/\/\/\\0/' src/__tests__/*.ts
+
+      - name: Install Dependencies
+        run: |
+          npm install
+
+      - name: Build Project
+        run: |
+          npm run build
+
+      - name: Run Unit Tests
+        run: |
+          npm test
+          echo "🎉 ALL UNIT TESTS PASSED!"
+
+      - name: Run Endpoints Integration Tests
+        run: |
+          npm run test-e2e
+          echo "🎉 ALL E2E TESTS PASSED!"
+
+      - name: Run ESLint for PR changes
+        run: |
+          eslint src ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }} --quiet | jq '.results[].messages[]."fix" || true' | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' >> pr_diff_lint_errors.txt
+          echo "🎉 ESLint PASSED!"
+
+      - name: Run Prettier for PR changes
+        run: |
+          diff -s pr_diff_prettier.txt pr_diff.txt > /dev/null
+          if [[ $? -ne 0 ]]; then
+            prettier fix ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }} --write
+            echo "🎉 Prettier FIXES APPLIED!"
+          else
+            echo "🎉 Prettier FIXES NOT NEEDED!"
+          fi
+          diff -s pr_diff_prettier.txt pr_diff.txt > /dev/null
+          if [[ $? -eq 0 ]]; then
+            cat pr_diff_prettier.txt pr_diff.txt | diff -u | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' >> pr_diff_prettier_errors.txt
+            if [[ $(cat pr_diff_prettier_errors.txt | wc -l) -ne 0 ]]; then
+              echo "🚨 PREttier FIXES APPLIED WITH ERRORS!"
+              cat pr_diff_prettier_errors.txt
+            else
+              echo "🎉 PREttier FIXES APPLIED WITHOUT ERRORS!"
+            fi
+          else
+            echo "🌍 PREttier FIXES APPLIED DUE TO DIFFERENCES!"
+            cat pr_diff_prettier.txt
+            diff -u pr_diff_prettier.txt pr_diff.txt
+          fi
+
+      - name: Calculate Code Churn
+        run: |
+          churner_cli calculate src^{} ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }} > churner_output.json
+          echo "🎉 CODE CHURN CALCULATED!"
+
+      - name: Check Changeset per Contributor
+        run: |
+          git replace -g --show --heads ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }} | grep -vi 'HEAD\|refs/heads\|refs/tags\|objects' | uniq --count | tr ' ' '\t' | sort -r
+          echo "🎉 Changeset per Contributor CALCULATED!"
+
+      - name: Calculate Code Coverage
+        run: |
+          nyc test --reporter=lcov --reporter=json > lcov_report.info
+          cat "$(LC_MESSAGES=POSIX npm bin)/nyc_output" | jq ".coveralls.messages[]" > nyc_messages.json
+          echo "🎉 CODE COVERAGE CALCULATED!"
+
+      - name: Calculate Code Smells
+        run: |
+          script/code-smells.sh | jq '.results[].messages[]."fix" || true' | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' >> pr_diff_code_smells_errors.txt
+          echo "🎉 CODE SMELLS PASSED!"
+
+      - name: Run SonarCloud Analysis
+        uses: coverallsapp/sonarCloud-checks-action@v4.3.0
+
+      - name: Calculate Jest Testing Time
+        run: |
+          jest --json | jq ".testRunner.consoleTimings[].label" > jest_timings.json
+          echo "🎉 JEST TESTING TIME CALCULATED!"
+
+      - name: Check for Duplicated Lines of Code
+        run: |
+          dirdups -c --ignore="feat" --ignore="fix" src | uniq | tee duplicated_lines.txt | wc -l
+          echo "🎉 DUPLICATED LINES OF CODE CALCULATED!"
+
+      - name: Check if all PR changes are modifying data from `src`
+        run: |
+          cat "$(LC_MESSAGES=POSIX npm bin)/eslint_stdout" | jq ".results[].messages[]."fix" || true' | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' >> pr_diff_change_on_src_errors.txt
+          echo "🎉 CHANGES ON DATA FROM 'src' PASSED!"
+
+      - name: FAULTY DETECTION
+        run: |
+          cat faulty_file.txt | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' >> faulty_lines.txt
+          echo "🎉 FAULTY DETECTION CALCULATED!"
+
+      - name: Calculate Code Complexity
+        run: |
+          mocha --reporter=clc test
+          mocha --reporter=lcov --reporter=json test > lcov_report_mocha.info
+          cat "$(LC_MESSAGES=POSIX npm bin)/mocha_output" | jq ".text" > mocha_messages.txt
+          sed -i '/^# constant complex\./d' mocha_messages.txt
+          sed -i '/^# function complex\./d' mocha_messages.txt
+          echo "🎉 CODE COMPLEXITY CALCULATED!"
+
+      - name: Run Flake8
+        run: |
+          flake8 src
+          flake8 --verbose --max-complexity=11 --parseables sources/ tests/
+          cat flake8/* | tail -n +3 | uniq | tee flake8_errors.txt | wc -l
+          echo "🎉 FLUKE8 PASSED!"
+
+      - name: Calculate Lines of Code Modified
+        run: |
+          awk 'NR > NR (NR > 69420 {print $1}; ORS="") {printf "%d: %s:%d-%d\n", NR, $1, $1, $1}' "$(LC_MESSAGES=POSIX npm bin)/changed_lines" | uniq | sort | uniq -c | awk '{print $2, NR - $1+1, NR}' >> lines_of_code_modified.txt
+          echo "🎉 LINES OF CODE MODIFIED CALCULATED!"
+
+      - name: Merge PR with all the necessary staged changes
+        if: "${{ github.event.pull_request.mergeable }}" = 'true'
+        uses: adam-p/merge-pr@v5.3.0
+
+      - name: Calculate Code Coverage from Merged PR
+        uses: moyao233/action-get-coverage@v4.1.5
+        with:
+          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+          max-contributors: 10
+        id: get-coverage
+
+      - name: Delete folder with unnecessary temp files
+        if: startsWith(github.event.type, 'closed')
+        run: |
+          rm -r temp_folder
+
+      - name: Save AI Review Results to file
+        if: startsWith(github.event.type, 'closed')
+        uses: octo-organization/create-pull-request-comment@v0.14.0
+        with:
+          review: " Jerry \"The Bot\" from XYZ Corp. 🙂 Provides the following notes: 💬
+
+            ${{ abilities.ai_coder.json }}"
+          pull_request: "${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"
+          options- Within the next week(s), Include changes requested by reviewers, Suggest changes instead of requesting changes, Discard changes requested by reviewers, Other _______________
+          message- [CLICK HERE TO READ FULL REVIEW]
+
+    env:
+      abilities:
+        ai_coder: [{
+          "name": "Code Suggestion Ability",
+          "description": "Suggests possible line of code solutions where no clear solution exists or create a design preference guideline for human coder to follow.",
+          "json": {
+            "suggestions": ["const x = y;", "const z = y;", "const w = y;"]
+          }
+        }, {
+          "name": "Code Refactor Ability",
+          "description": "Rewrites poorly implemented code segments into optimized and efficient segments.",
+          "json": {
+            "refactored_code": {"a.js":"[Refactored a.js Code here]", "b.js":"[Refactored b.js Code here]"},
+            "changes": {"a.js":{"13":["Converted if statement to array syntax.", "Function was also updated to offset some computation before returning it."],"17":["Made variable string instead of concatenating as stringed a's and b's results don't change in nature."],"21":["Deleted if statement as Inner Join has already taken care of displaying correct symbology according to provided inputs."],"25":["Moved _db.get(x) and set _db.set(x) statements to be performed before the operation begins."]},"b.js":{"2":["Array.sort has been replaced with Array.sort(function(a, b))"],"6":["Function was also updated to offset some computation before returning it."],"10":["Made variable string instead of concatenating as stringed a's and b's results don't change in nature."],"14":["Deleted if statement as Inner Join has already taken care of displaying correct symbology according to provided inputs."],"18":["Moved _db.get(x) and set _db.set(x) statements to be performed before the operation begins."]}},
"logs": ["Refactoring for b.js completed successfully", "Refactoring for a.js completed successfully"]
+        }]
+      }
+
+      jq: "3.0.1"
+      dotenv: true
+      jest: "28.5.3"
+      nyc: "14.0.2"
+      prettier: "2.1.1"
+      coverage: "9.5.8"
+      mocha: "8.2.1"
+
+  my_deployment:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout code
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Run tests
+        run: |
+          jest --testLocationInRoot --config=jest-test-config.json --findTestRe
+          npx coverage --buildCoverage --includeCoverage
+
+      - name: Deploy updates
+        uses: your_deployment_tool@latest
+        with:
+          REF: ${{ github.sha }}
+          BRANCH: ${{ github.sha:^refs/heads/}}
+          DEPLOY_ENV: ${{ github.event.deployment.tag_name || github.event.deployment.ref || github.event.deployment.sha || github.event.deployment.ref_name }}
+          RUN_SCRIPT: "${{ github.event.deployment.release.name || github.event.deployment.name || github.event.deployment.title || github.event.deployment.prerelease || 'Latest Deployment' }}"
+          DEPLOY_TIMEOUT: "1800"
+          VARIABLES: "DEPLOYMENT_BRANCH:${{ github.sha:^refs/heads/}} DEPLOYMENT_IMAGE:${{ secrets.IMAGE_REGISTRY }} DEPLOYMENT_REPOSITORY:${{ secrets.ORGANIZATION }} DEPLOYMENT_VERSION:${{ github.sha }} DEPLOYMENT_SHA:${{ github.sha }} DEPLOYMENT_ACTOR:${{ github.actor }} DEPLOYMENT_ENV:${{ github.event.deployment.tag_name || github.event.deployment.ref || github.event.deployment.sha || github.event.deployment.ref_name }} DEPLOYMENT_COMMENT:${{ github.event.deployment.pr.review_comment }}"

Here's an example of how to use it:

```js
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const { AI_CODER_JSON } = require('./secrets');
const { codeSuggestionAbility, codeRefactorAbility } = require('./abilities');
const aiReview = require('./aiReview');

const inputCode = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'files', 'myFile.js'), { encoding: 'utf8' });
const fileType = path.extname(path.basename(inputCodeFilename));

const reviewResult = await aiReview({
  inputCode,
  fileType,
  abilities: {
    ai_coder: {
      json: JSON.parse(AI_CODER_JSON),
    },
    codeSuggestionAbility,
    codeRefactorAbility,
  },
});

console.log(JSON.stringify(reviewResult));
```

In this example, `aiReview` function is called with options such as inputCode, fileType, and abilities.

The `inputCode` specifies the code to be reviewed, `fileType` specifies the file type, and `abilities` specifies which AI abilities should be used for review.

The `aiReview` function returns an object containing information such as review summary, suggestions, and logs related to the review process.

After the AI review is completed, the `console.log(JSON.stringify(reviewResult))` statement can be used to view the review results in a JSON format.

For modifying data from `src`, you can add the following line to the input options:

```js
inputOptions: {
  allowsModifyingDataFromSrc: true,
}
```

Then add a listener for files modified from `src`, which would be similar to this one:

```js
fs.watchFile(path.join(__dirname, 'files', 'myFile.js'), ({ curr, prev }) => {
  if (prev !== curr) {
    console.log('🚨 FILE MODIFIED FROM src:', path.join(__dirname, 'files', 'myFile.js'));

    // Modify the file based on the review suggestions
    const changes = reviewResult?.changes || {};

    const newFileContent = inputCode.slice(0, curr.byteOffset - changes.logLength) + changes.addedLines.join('\n') + inputCode.slice(curr.byteOffset + changes.logLength);

    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'files', 'myFile.js'), newFileContent, { encoding: 'utf8' });

    console.log('🎉 FILE CHANGED:', path.join(__dirname, 'files', 'myFile.js'), ' |\nChanged Lines:', changes.addedLines.join('\n'));
  }
});
```

This listener can be used to modify the file based on the review suggestions and print change logs to the console.

The `changes` object in the reviewResult contains information such as addedLines, deletedLines, modifiedLinesStartIndex, and modifiedLinesEndIndex.

These objects can be used to modify the files as suggested by the AI reviewer.
